sceneConcept: A tired thirty-six-year-old Chinese collection enforcer stands alone against a transparent background. Short untidy dark brown hair, brown eyes, under-eye shadows and a worried frown make him look pressured rather than cruel. A faded dark red work jacket hangs open over a grey hoodie with its hood down, dark cargo trousers, a utility belt and battered work boots. Only his right hand and lower wrist are mechanical: a bulky outdated prosthesis built from scratched dull-steel plates and exposed rivets. His left hand lightly checks the prosthetic wrist coupling. Soft even frontal studio light keeps the metal matte. Visual refresh: only the right hand below the wrist replaced by a battered old prosthesis, paired with layered red streetwear.
naturalLanguageDetail: A pressured Chinese collection enforcer in layered red streetwear displays a battered old Chongli prosthesis replacing only his right hand below the wrist while both forearms remain human beneath his sleeves under soft even frontal studio light.
